prompt:
We just onboarded a legacy payments module into our monorepo at `projects/legacy-payments-module` and the platform team needs a machine-readable snapshot of its folder layout for automated ingestion into our internal wiki system. The wiki importer only accepts JSON, and for performance reasons it can only handle two levels of directory depth — anything deeper causes the importer to crash.

Please produce a file called `structure.json` containing the folder hierarchy of `projects/legacy-payments-module`, limited to 2 levels deep, in JSON format.
